[capture()](../fast-element.connectionguard.capture/)


</td><td>


</td><td>

Captures the current connection and returns a predicate that checks it. A capture made while disconnected never becomes current. Register the guard before preparation behaviors to capture during pre-bind preparation; that capture becomes current once the controller connects. Disconnecting permanently invalidates captures from that connection. This does not cancel work or release resources.
